title: Skill System Deep Dive: Three Lanes of Progress
excerpt: A look at how background, idle, and active skill lanes work together to keep your world ticking around the clock.

body.text: Evermarch is built around three concurrent ways to make progress: background work that continues while you are away, an idle lane for ongoing training, and an active lane for hands-on play.
The key rule is simple: actively playing should add to what your world is already doing. Choosing a hands-on activity should never erase the progress from your background or idle lanes.

items: Background progression supports long-term activities such as farming.
Idle progression keeps one chosen skill moving while the game is open.
Active progression rewards focused play with an additional hands-on activity.
